Res.Caption: Company
Res.FullDescription: The company which this template can be applied in. When left empty the template can be applied in all companies.

Res.Caption: Partial Template
Res.FullDescription: Partial templates are not applied to jobs except when used on a TMP Completion Trigger Action.

Res.Caption: Universal Template
Res.FullDescription: Universal templates are defined a maximum of once per Process Type. They contain items that should be applied to all jobs of this type.

Res.Caption: Effective Start Date
Res.FullDescription: Date from which this workflow template will start to be applicable to jobs. (Using the creation time of the job).

Res.Caption: Effective End Date
Res.FullDescription: Date from which this workflow template will cease to be applicable to jobs.

Res.Caption: Fallback Method
Res.FullDescription: Configure the method to determine whether custom fields from less specific Workflow Templates will be applied to jobs when this template is applied.

Res.Caption: Fallback Method
Res.FullDescription: Configure the method to determine whether tasks from less specific Workflow Templates will be applied to jobs when this template is applied.

Res.Caption: Fallback Method
Res.FullDescription: Configure the method to determine whether milestones from less specific Workflow Templates will be applied to jobs when this template is applied.

Res.Caption: Fallback Method
Res.FullDescription: Configure the method to determine whether triggers from less specific Workflow Templates will be applied to jobs when this template is applied.

Res.Caption: Fallback Method
Res.FullDescription: Configure the method to determine whether validation rules from less specific Workflow Templates will be applied to jobs when this template is applied.

Res.Caption: Fallback Method
Res.FullDescription: Configure the method to determine whether Release Group Rules from less specific Workflow Templates will be considered for jobs when this template is matched.

Res.Caption: Buffer Management System
Res.FullDescription: The Buffer Management System which workflows created from this template will become a part of. If no system is selected here, workflows will become part of the system configured for this Process Type.

Res.Caption: Fallback to Other Template
Res.FullDescription: Ignore the screen layout configured against this Workflow Template and instead use the Screen Layout of the next closest matching Template. If no templates match then the default Screen Layout will be applied.
